patch_description:
Enhance the ansatz by:
1. Introducing ZZZ (MultiRZ) gates on all 8 tic-tac-toe winning lines to encode three-qubit correlations directly.
2. Adding selective CCRZ gates on strategic triples (center + two corners).
3. Simplifying pre/post-entanglement rotations with parameter sharing across symmetric qubit groups (corners, edges, center) to maintain parameter efficiency while freeing capacity for three-qubit gates.
4. Keeping single-qubit RY rotations unshared to preserve per-qubit flexibility.

This inductive bias leverages domain knowledge: winning lines are fundamental to tic-tac-toe, and three-qubit interactions can capture their correlations better than only two-qubit nearest-neighbor gates. The architecture increases expressivity per parameter while reducing the generalization gap.
